homebrew_distribution.verified_pipeline_contract: The Dagger resolver selects stable actions-runtime-X.Y.Z only, requires both upstream Linux and macOS-arm64 assets, validates their GitHub SHA-256 digests, mirrors them into action-server-X.Y.Z, and renders/commits the updated cask. required_release_sequence: After upstream Runtime GitHub assets exist and their digest manifest has been independently checked, run maintained Tap Manual action=ci with package_id=action-server and require success.

Then run Tap Manual action=release with package_id=action-server. Verify the resulting action-server-1.0.3 tap release, its Linux and macOS mirrored asset digests, and committed Casks/action-server.rb version/URL/hash on joshyorko/homebrew-tools main.
Require the resulting Tap CI push run's action-server artifact check to pass.

Obtain actual Homebrew install and upgrade proof on Linux x86_64 and macOS arm64: clean install with brew install --cask joshyorko/tools/action-server; update from existing Runtime 1.0.1 using brew update && brew upgrade --cask joshyorko/tools/action-server; verify action-server version reports 1.0.3 and installed executable bytes correspond to the verified platform cask asset. Preserve command logs, host/OS/architecture, tap commit, cask and asset hashes. This proof is an explicit release gate, not optional.

For migration from historical Action Server 1.2.6, follow the documented explicit brew reinstall --cask joshyorko/tools/action-server path because Runtime 1.0.3 compares lower numerically. Record this separately from a normal 1.0.1-to-1.0.3 brew upgrade.
homebrew_distribution.workflow_credential_boundary: Tap Manual's run uses ${{ secrets.DAGGER_CLOUD_TOKEN }} for Dagger and the repository GITHUB_TOKEN for release/commit. Actions PyPI uses PYPI_TOKEN_ACTIONS_RUNTIME in the pypi environment. Secret values and presence were not checked. The gh account's repository permissions are metadata, not proof that workflow secrets are configured or valid.
